name: Bases Note Templates
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Renders template variables in nested YAML lists and mappings.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Template variables now fill in inside nested lists and mappings.
Filter property names with accented or non-Latin characters now work.
tip: Let a filter value override the template's property so new notes match the view.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Note Templates is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
